# Logoinn

> Logoinn is a professional logo design, website design, and digital marketing agency founded in 2001, serving 75,000+ clients across the USA, UK, Australia, New Zealand, and globally. The company is operated by ITSec Limited (registered in England, No. 4047064), headquartered in Leicester, UK. Logoinn is ISO certified, Microsoft certified, and Google Certified. All designers are in-house. Every project includes a 100% money-back guarantee.

Logoinn provides affordable, custom branding and digital services for startups, small businesses, and enterprises. Core offerings include logo design (from $59), website design (from $279), SEO services (from $299), PPC management, promotional videos, mobile app development, brochure design, and email marketing. Initial consultations are free. Designs are typically delivered within 24–48 hours.

## Logo Design Packages

All packages include 100% satisfaction guarantee and delivery of final files in AI (vector), PSD, PNG, JPG, GIF, and TIFF formats.

- **Basic** – $59 (was $79): 2 concepts, 1 revision, 1 designer, 24-hour delivery, email support.
- **Startup** – $99 (was $109): 4 concepts, 3 revisions, 2 designers, 24-hour delivery, business card + stationery included, phone support.
- **Unlimited** – $145 (was $165): Unlimited concepts and revisions, 8 designers, 24-hour delivery, full stationery suite (business card, letterhead, email signature, MS Word letterhead, fax template), dedicated account manager, phone support.
- **Illustration** – $249 (was $269): 2 hand-drawn concepts, 2 revisions, 2 designers, 4-business-day delivery, dedicated account manager.
- **3D Logo** – $399 (was $499): 1 concept, 72-hour delivery, 1 designer, phone support.
- **Startup Gold** – $675 (was $775): Unlimited concepts + revisions, 8 designers, full stationery, plus a complete multi-page website with CMS, responsive design, hosting, and dedicated account manager.

## Website Design Packages

- **Single Page** – $279: Custom design, 12-month hosting, Google search integration, 2 stock photos, search engine submission, 1 email account.
- **WordPress Simple** – $499: 3 pages, free domain, free logo, responsive, blog, social media integration, CMS (WordPress).
- **Website Silver** – $449: 6 pages, free domain, Google Analytics, Google Page Speed tested, W3C compliant, CMS, responsive.
- **Website Gold** – $999: 15 pages, free domain, free logo, Google Analytics, social integration, CMS, 24/7 monitoring, responsive.
- **Website Platinum** – $1,350: 40 pages, free logo, free 30-second explainer video with voiceover, free domain, CMS, blog, 24/7 monitoring, social integration.
- **Magento Shopping Cart** – $1,999: Full e-commerce solution with multiple stores, ERP integration, advanced reporting, SEO-friendly, B2B/B2C capable.

## SEO & Marketing Packages

- **SEO Booster** – $299 (one-time): Search engine submissions, meta tag optimisation, image tag optimisation, sitemap setup, robots.txt, Google Analytics integration, Google Map indexing, comprehensive on-page SEO report (up to 5 pages).
- **SEO Retainer** – $299/month: All Booster features plus monthly keyword ranking reports, continuous link building, ranking monitoring, and monthly link building reports.
- **PPC Startup** – $149 (one-time setup): PPC account setup, competition analysis, keyword research, campaign planning, ad creation, free AdWords credit.
- **PPC Ongoing** – $249/month: Campaign monitoring, new opportunity identification, conversion tracking, spend analysis, free AdWords credit.
